clue.text: What the psychiatrist did flashed through a person's thoughts

definitions.meaning: first meaning, read playfully: a psychiatrist literally goes inside a patient's head
second meaning: the ordinary idiom for an idea suddenly occurring to someone

explanation.walkthrough: The first half is a whimsical literal reading of the phrase; the second is its everyday idiomatic sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes an idea occurring to someone, while the jokey reading pictures a therapist getting inside a patient's head.

clue.text: It is currently attractive to choose or come up with ten upstanding in magic

parts.note: to elect is to choose

indicators.note: in a down entry, coming up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: taken as written, then turned upwards

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other, sitting within it

parts.note: taken as written, to receive the inserted piece

indicators.note: standing up in a down answer means the word is written bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written, then turned upwards

explanation.surface: A strange instruction to pick something and plant an upright ten inside a conjuring trick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Currently' is the pun: an electric current produces this kind of attraction, so the opening words are the definition, not a remark about fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: An electromagnet attracts iron only while electric current flows, so the wit lies in the double sense of current.

clue.text: Shield bearer or butt ever short

indicators.note: something short is missing a bit, so a letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: a butt is a target, as in the butt of a joke or an archery butt
loses its V, giving the poetic contraction e'er

explanation.surface: A puzzled question over whether something is a knight's attendant or the butt of eternal jokes.
explanation.walkthrough: E'er is the poetic contraction of ever. A target was also an old word for a small round shield.
explanation.definitionFit: A targeteer was a foot soldier armed with a target, an old word for a small round shield.

clue.text: Right poorly in race

parts.note: R is the standard abbreviation for right
feeling poorly means being unwell

explanation.surface: Someone is unwell while competing in a race, which is unfortunate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Race' looks like a running contest, but here it is a channel of flowing water, as in a mill race.
explanation.definitionFit: A race is a fast-flowing channel of water, and a rill is a small brook or stream.

clue.text: District Attorney is taking the platform

parts.note: DA is the usual abbreviation for an American district attorney
taken as written

explanation.surface: A prosecutor steps up to the podium to speak in court.
explanation.definitionFit: A dais is a raised stage at one end of a hall, a low platform for speakers or dignitaries.

clue.text: Darkness and shadow following deadly drug

parts.note: night is the time of darkness
shade is a synonym of shadow

explanation.surface: Gloom and shadows close in after someone takes a lethal dose.
explanation.walkthrough: NIGHT + SHADE. The plant's full name is deadly nightshade, so 'deadly' points straight at it.
explanation.definitionFit: Deadly nightshade, or belladonna, is a poisonous plant whose extracts such as atropine are used as drugs.

clue.text: Solemn person forming TT teams

parts.note: TT means teetotal, someone who never drinks alcohol
a side is a team in sport

explanation.surface: A serious figure organises sports teams of non-drinkers.
explanation.walkthrough: TT stands for teetotal, a crossword staple for someone who abstains.
explanation.definitionFit: A sobersides is an informal term for a serious, humourless individual who rarely smiles.

clue.text: Send out children for a publication

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to distribute or release officially
second meaning: offspring, as in dying without heirs
third meaning: one edition of a magazine or journal

explanation.surface: Packing the kids off so that a newspaper can be read in peace.
explanation.walkthrough: Three separate meanings of one word; 'for' simply joins two of them.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to distribute officially, offspring in legal language, and one numbered edition of a magazine.

clue.text: Spirit arranged a vile tryst showing feeling

parts.note: a demon is an evil spirit

indicators.note: arranged means put into a new order, so these letters are reorganised

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A wicked spirit sets up a sordid secret meeting with plenty of emotion.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting demonstratively means openly expressing emotions such as affection, rather than keeping them hidden inside.

clue.text: Registering unusually long liner

indicators.note: unusually suggests something out of its normal state, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Checking in for a voyage on an exceptionally lengthy ocean liner.
explanation.definitionFit: Enrolling means signing up officially, adding one's name to a list, register or course.

clue.text: Thunder round the south gives heart

indicators.note: going round something means surrounding it, so one piece wraps the other

parts.note: a boom is the deep roar of thunder
S is the abbreviation for south

explanation.surface: A storm rolling across southern parts sets the pulse racing.
explanation.definitionFit: The bosom is the breast and, figuratively, the seat of feelings, just as the heart is.

clue.text: Kicked towards the editor

parts.note: to means towards, indicating direction
ED is the standard abbreviation for editor

explanation.surface: Someone booted something at the newspaper editor in anger.
explanation.definitionFit: To toe a ball is to strike it with the tip of one's foot, which is a kind of kick.

clue.text: The way to encourage fish

parts.note: ST, short for street, is a way
to urge on is to encourage

explanation.surface: Advice on how best to coax a fish onto the hook.
explanation.definitionFit: The sturgeon is a large, bony freshwater and marine fish prized as the source of caviar.

clue.text: Obstruction before opening a particle

parts.note: pre- is the prefix meaning before
a vent is an opening that lets air or gas escape
an ion is a charged atomic particle

explanation.surface: Something blocks the way before a tiny particle can get through a gap.
explanation.definitionFit: Prevention is the act of stopping something happening, hindering it much as a blockage does.

clue.text: Until a real change occurs it's one-sided

indicators.note: a change alters the arrangement, so the letters are put in a new order

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A complaint that matters remain lopsided until genuine reform comes along.
explanation.definitionFit: A unilateral decision is made by a single party, without the agreement of others involved.

clue.text: Ended race having exceeded the time

parts.note: something that has ended is over
ran is the past tense of run, to race

explanation.surface: A race finished late because it went on longer than scheduled.
explanation.definitionFit: A meeting or programme that overran continued beyond its allotted slot, going on longer than planned.

clue.text: Bob getting fibre wound

parts.note: a hair is a single fine fibre
a cut is a wound

explanation.surface: A man named Bob ends up with an injury from some thread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bob' looks like a man's name, but it is a short hairstyle.
explanation.definitionFit: A bob is a particular short hairstyle, cut level around the head, so it is a specific example.

clue.text: Lubricant making furniture more mobile?

parts.note: surface reading: some grease you would apply to make a sofa slide around more easily
setter's reading: the small wheels on chair legs plus a lubricant, a laxative famous for getting things moving

explanation.walkthrough: Castors are the little wheels fitted to furniture legs; the medicinal oil shares the name and was traditionally used as a laxative.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a pale vegetable oil from the castor bean, used as an industrial lubricant and laxative.

clue.text: Artist turns to opponent landing

indicators.note: turning round makes the word face the other way, read right to left

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, the crossword's usual artist
a rival is an opponent

explanation.surface: A painter faces a competitor who is coming in to land.
explanation.definitionFit: An aircraft's landing is its arrival, the moment it reaches its destination and touches down.

clue.text: Two oceans and 3 feature thereof

wordplay.note: the deep and the sea are both names for the ocean

explanation.surface: A puzzling note about two oceans and some feature found in them.
explanation.walkthrough: The '3' is a cross-reference that does not line up with clue 3 in this grid as printed; read it as something found far out in the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep-sea describes the remote abyssal depths of the ocean, far from shore, and things found there.

clue.text: Name no friend goes round in

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: going round something means encircling it, so one piece wraps around another

parts.note: a mate is a friend
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone with no friends to put forward for a position goes around in circles.
explanation.definitionFit: To name someone for a post or award is to nominate, putting them forward as a candidate.

clue.text: Drive doctor to right

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a military doctor
taken as written
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: A medic is told to keep to the right while driving.
explanation.definitionFit: To motor is to travel by car, an old-fashioned verb meaning to go for a drive.

clue.text: Flamingo birds concealing arid area

indicators.note: concealing means keeping something tucked away inside the following words

parts.note: the letters run across the join of the two words

explanation.surface: A flock of flamingos hides away in a parched desert landscape.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gobi is a vast desert spanning Mongolia and northern China, among the driest places in Asia.

clue.text: Eager to go up after silver

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

indicators.note: in a down entry going up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: taken as written, then turned upwards

explanation.surface: Someone keen to climb higher in pursuit of riches.
explanation.definitionFit: Agog describes someone excited and keen, impatiently waiting to hear or see something.

clue.text: Powder found in hospital cabinet

indicators.note: found in means sitting inside the following words, waiting to be picked out

parts.note: the letters run across the join of the two words

explanation.surface: A tin of dusting powder kept in a hospital's medicine cupboard.
explanation.definitionFit: Talc is a soft mineral ground into a fine white powder used on skin.

clue.text: All together making an exclamation of rebuke before it returns

parts.note: tut is a sound of disapproval

indicators.note: something that returns comes back the way it went, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written, then turned round

explanation.surface: A group of people all tutting disapprovingly at the same moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutti is the Italian musical direction telling every performer to play at once, as a full ensemble.

clue.text: To fix mother with a part requires long-winded explanation

parts.note: to rig a contest is to fix it
ma is an informal word for mother
a role is a part in a play

explanation.surface: Fixing things for mum and her role in a show needs a tedious explanation.
explanation.definitionFit: A rigmarole is a lengthy, rambling and confused account or procedure that drags on tiresomely.

clue.text: Only local rich go to be arranged in correct order of date

indicators.note: arranged means set out afresh, so the letters are put into a new sequence

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Only wealthy residents may leave, and they must line up by date.
explanation.definitionFit: Chronologically means sequenced by time, with earlier events placed before later ones.
